name: command-dark
description: Command-centre briefing preset: dark ground, tactical grid, one blue signal, category colours, Geist. Use for defence, government operations and intelligence audiences.

reasons.mode: Dark by design: command-centre briefings are presented in dim operations rooms.
reasons.grid: The tactical grid is the identity motif of this preset, and content aligns to its lines.
reasons.uppercase: Wide-tracked uppercase eyebrows and labels match the formal operations-room style.
reasons.font: Geist is a free Google Font with a matching mono cut for codes and figures.
reasons.categoryColours: c1 to c4 mark categories such as operational domains and always travel with their label.
